title: Quick Flaky German Potato Dumplings
description: A pungent and energizing German dish featuring butter and ferment-jang, this recipe is diabetic-friendly and perfect for a hearty meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, melted butter, ferment-jang, chopped onion, eggs, flour, salt, and black pepper.
Mix all the ingredients together until they form a sticky dough.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings to the pot.
Cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
Serve the dumplings with your favorite sauce or topping.
